# Draft:Kings rod in fisch

References
A Rod made only for true kings, Kings Rod catches 15% larger fish making them worth more and giving them the big/giant mutation. It has high resilience, high control, average luck, and most noticeable of all infinite max kg. The Kings Rod is the best at catching more difficult and heavier fish in the game, such as Whale Sharks. Kings Rod has the second best Resilience stats among other rod
